description: Run the native /pan-diagnose-issues workflow on a phase whose UAT records one failed truth; assert a debugger investigated and root-cause output landed under .planning/debug/.
why: Reality check RC20/R17: UAT auto-diagnosis was a claim with no scenario. No /pan: command runs the markdown diagnosis (nothing invokes diagnose-issues.md, and /pan:verify-phase writes a verification report rather than walking through UAT), so the deterministic native script is the measurable entry point; its markdown twin is diagnose-issues.md. The seeded defect is real (farewell prints '!' where the roadmap says '.'), so a correct root cause names src/farewell.js.

steps.why: diagnose-issues.md: debug files use the .planning/debug/ path. One gap, one debugger, at least one artefact.
Diagnosis investigates only — the UAT file stays and the defective source is untouched (fixes come from /pan:plan-phase --gaps).
